identity_policy.lesson: preserve source lesson ID; revision tracked separately; competing versions cannot both be active
identity_policy.lexeme: retain existing CS-LEX IDs as candidate identity; match lemma + POS + sense before aliasing external IDs
identity_policy.form: distinct stable ID, exact NFC surface, lexeme/sense relation, grammatical features, source, review status; phrase fragments distinct from full sentences
identity_policy.utterance: preserve source utterance IDs; exact text match produces candidates only; context/role/voice approval needed before deduplication
identity_policy.audio: text revision + locale + role + asset hash and approval; no private URLs
identity_policy.step: source lesson ID + revision + original step ID or ordinal; never use ordinal to migrate mastery across revisions
identity_policy.event: immutable attempt ID, target ID, skill, result, assistance, timestamp, source revision; retain old progress separately until explicit migration
identity_policy.frequency: unknown stays null; do not infer ranks from teaching order

candidate_schema.rule: Draft only; schema requires implementation and validation before runtime use.

greeting_collision.decision: PR35 revised speaking sequence is candidate interaction source; PR32 15 functions are reference not second active lesson. Resolve content and language before activation.

progress_migration.policy: read-only import later; old keys retained; never convert completion or transcript matches into mastery

unresolved: full lemma/sense/form aliases and item-level audio mapping
exact cross-source prerequisite and grammar validation
canonical runtime integration and real audio/device validation
